AI tools fade into the background when they become routine. I built a RAG system that saved me 3.5 hours per QA cycle. Then I stopped noticing it.

To fix it, I started treating AI like a junior teammate. New tasks daily, outside my usual workflow. Found 3 edge cases in my pipeline I’d overlooked.

Full write-up: https://www.adilaidev.com/blog/ai-blindness-is-real-heres-how-to-fix-it
